The '''Bilbousa Bazaar''' was a marketplace on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in the capital city [[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]]. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]) visited the marketplace to buy weapons from [[Pablo/Legends|Pablo]].
